SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  p.country,
  (p.properties->>'stall_count')::int AS stall_count,
  (p.properties->>'max_power_kw')::int AS max_power_kw,
  p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring}
), details AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT pricebook->>'currencyCode', ', ' ORDER BY pricebook->>'currencyCode')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(
          CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) AS e(pricebook)
        WHERE NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') IS NOT NULL
      ),
      'n/a'
    ) AS pricebook_currency
  FROM selected p
)
SELECT field, value
FROM details p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('Name', p.name),
    ('POI ID', p.id::text),
    ('Address', concat_ws(', ', NULLIF(p.address->>'street', ''), NULLIF(p.address->>'city', ''), NULLIF(p.address->>'state', ''), NULLIF(p.address->>'postcode', ''), NULLIF(p.address->>'country', ''))),
    ('Currency', p.pricebook_currency),
    ('Catalog Age', (now() - p.updated_at)::text),
    ('Updated At', to_char(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI UTC')),
    ('Tesla URL', p.info_url)
) AS detail(field, value);

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring}
), pricebooks AS (
  SELECT
    pricebook,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType', '') AS vehicle_make_type,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') AS currency,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'startTime', '') AS start_time,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'endTime', '') AS end_time,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'minSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS min_site_occupancy,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'maxSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS max_site_occupancy
  FROM selected p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS e(pricebook)
  WHERE pricebook->>'feeType' = 'CHARGING'
    AND pricebook->>'uom' = 'kwh'
    AND NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '') IS NOT NULL
), hourly_windows AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE WHEN start_time ~ '^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$' THEN split_part(start_time, ':', 1)::int END AS start_hour,
    CASE WHEN end_time ~ '^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$' THEN split_part(end_time, ':', 1)::int END AS end_hour
  FROM pricebooks
), expanded AS (
  SELECT
    h.hour,
    w.vehicle_make_type,
    w.rate_base,
    w.start_hour IS NOT NULL AND w.end_hour IS NOT NULL AND w.start_hour <> w.end_hour AS has_time_window,
    w.min_site_occupancy IS NOT NULL OR w.max_site_occupancy IS NOT NULL AS has_occupancy_band
  FROM hourly_windows w
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hour)
  WHERE start_hour IS NULL
     OR end_hour IS NULL
     OR start_hour = end_hour
     OR (start_hour < end_hour AND h.hour >= start_hour AND h.hour < end_hour)
     OR (start_hour > end_hour AND (h.hour >= start_hour OR h.hour < end_hour))
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY hour, vehicle_make_type
      ORDER BY has_time_window DESC, has_occupancy_band ASC, rate_base ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM expanded
)
SELECT
  lpad(hours.hour::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS hour_label,
  max(ranked.rate_base) FILTER (WHERE ranked.vehicle_make_type = 'TSLA' AND ranked.rn = 1)::double precision AS tsla_price,
  max(ranked.rate_base) FILTER (WHERE ranked.vehicle_make_type = 'NTSLA' AND ranked.rn = 1)::double precision AS non_tesla_price
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS hours(hour)
LEFT JOIN ranked ON ranked.hour = hours.hour
GROUP BY hours.hour
ORDER BY hours.hour ASC;

SELECT
  e.row_num,
  e.pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' AS vehicle_make_type,
  e.pricebook->>'feeType' AS fee_type,
  e.pricebook->>'currencyCode' AS currency,
  e.pricebook->>'uom' AS unit,
  e.pricebook->>'startTime' AS start_time,
  e.pricebook->>'endTime' AS end_time,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier1', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_1,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'rateTier2', '')::numeric AS rate_tier_2,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'minSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS min_site_occupancy,
  NULLIF(e.pricebook->>'maxSiteOccupancy', '')::numeric AS max_site_occupancy,
  e.pricebook->>'isMemberPricebook' AS member_pricebook,
  e.pricebook AS raw_pricebook
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
  CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(pricebook, row_num)
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring}
ORDER BY e.row_num ASC;

SELECT
  p.provider_ref,
  p.address,
  p.properties->'pricebooks' AS pricebooks,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'index' AS upstream_index,
  p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' AS upstream_detail,
  p.properties AS raw_properties
FROM pois p
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND p.category = 'supercharger'
  AND ${supercharger_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${supercharger_id:sqlstring};

list.name: supercharger_id
list.query:
WITH matches AS (
  SELECT
    id::text || ' - ' || name || COALESCE(' [' || NULLIF(region, '') || ']', '') AS __text,
    id::text AS __value,
    name,
    id
  FROM pois
  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    AND category = 'supercharger'
    AND (${supercharger_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || ${supercharger_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')
    AND CASE
      WHEN ${supercharger_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true
      WHEN ${supercharger_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN id::text = ${supercharger_id_search:sqlstring}
      ELSE false
    END
    AND (${supercharger_source_id_search:sqlstring} = '' OR source_id ILIKE '%' || ${supercharger_source_id_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  ORDER BY name ASC, id ASC
  LIMIT 500
)
SELECT __text, __value FROM matches
UNION ALL
SELECT 'No matching Tesla supercharger' AS __text, '__none' AS __value
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches)
